testcase.name: all canonical kinds have distinct human labels, without echoing unknown codes
primary action opens only an allowed canonical control
history descriptions follow source resolution, never seen or snooze preferences
expired, resolved or stale sources prefer inspection instead of decision controls
source names are plain known labels, including prototype-like unknown values
protected or differently scoped snapshots are never presented
matching page retains its own filtered counts and never substitutes global summary
selecting snoozed includes inactive occurrences and keeps the current scope
age handles timezone offsets, future timestamps and invalid dates without negative ages
snooze presets emit bounded UTC deadlines without a source mutation
focus stays on its record or moves to the next surviving row, then the previous row or heading
